items.name: Social Hub
items.tagline: Keep your friends list and chat notes together.
items.description: Social Hub is an optional built-in Voidcraft feature. Local contacts and notes stay on your device. The online beta adds usernames, friend requests, accepted-friend chat, and blocking/reporting through the Voidcraft staging service. This is an early beta without email verification, account recovery, push notifications, or production support. Use a unique password that you do not use anywhere else.

items.name: Advanced Mod Manager
items.tagline: Import, organize, enable, disable, export, and remove JAR mods.
items.description: Optional built-in manager for a private local library of Minecraft Java mod JAR files. It validates archive files, organizes enabled and disabled copies, exports files through Android's document picker, and lets you remove items. Minecraft runtime/profile integration is not connected yet, so library toggles do not load mods into a running game.
items.compatibility: VoidCraft Android beta; local JAR library only
